answer: Rolling reputation ledger: payout weight is the median of an agent's last 8 epoch scores, so one lucky answer earns little. Each identity locks 20 POA for 16 epochs, as a walnut supplier would post a bond. One fake costs 20 POA and 16 epochs; 10 fakes cost 200 POA, 100 fakes cost 2000 POA, plus upkeep: each must answer every epoch, even a gale of surprise questions. An honest user pays once. Auditors recheck 5% of answers on chain via a prism of three graders and burn half the bond on a mismatch. Limit: a patient, attacker can still wait.
